description: Update one i18n key. Overwrite a single existing key's value — the only overwrite path.

description.description: Optional human note to store with the key.

id.description: A resource path identifier — an opaque `xxx_<ULID>` id (~30 chars) or the resource's `name`/`key`. 1–128 characters; the upper bound matches the longest name/key any resource accepts, so an over-long value can never name a real row.

value.description: New value for the key (the only overwrite path).

variables.description: Explicit `{{var}}` placeholder names in the value. Omit to auto-derive them from the value.

name: i18n_keys_update
